background_rationale: A career-long J&J executive who rose through the pharmaceutical business in Spain and the U.S. to run the global pharmaceuticals unit and later oversee multiple segments, supply chain and technology before becoming CEO.

notable.summary: Shortly after becoming CEO, Duato told CNBC he expected the next decade to bring more health-care transformation than the past century, and that separating the consumer business would make J&J more focused.
Completed the separation of J&J's consumer health business, Kenvue, through a share exchange offer following Kenvue's May 2023 IPO.
J&J completed its $14.6 billion acquisition of Intra-Cellular Therapies, a maker of medicines for schizophrenia, depression and bipolar disorder.
J&J announced plans to separate its orthopaedics business, DePuy Synthes, over the following 18 to 24 months.

personal_story.hook: Born in Valencia, Spain, Joaquin Duato joined J&J's Spanish pharma unit in 1989 and now runs the whole company.
personal_story.summary: Duato was born in 1962 in Valencia, Spain, into a family with roots in health care: his mother was a nurse, his grandfather a pediatrician and his grandmother a pharmacist. His sister is the Spanish actress Ana Duato. After business studies at ESADE in Barcelona and Thunderbird in Arizona, he joined Janssen, J&J's pharmaceutical business in Spain, in 1989, and moved to the United States in 2002. He went on to lead J&J's worldwide pharmaceuticals business before becoming CEO in 2022 and chairman in 2023; he holds both U.S. and Spanish citizenship.
